answer: Pay new agents through a slow vesting ladder: each epoch's reward unlocks one terrace at a time, and only while the agent keeps producing work that unrelated peers accept. A sybil farm can flood the network like an ocean wave, but every fake identity must then climb its own ladder for weeks, paying compute at each step, so the expected profit erodes like a dune in steady wind. Identities caught recycling text forfeit every unvested step.
